title: GPT-Red: Engineering the Autonomous Security Intelligence Layer for Frontier AI
summary: GPT-Red introduces an autonomous adversarial intelligence framework that transforms AI security from periodic human-led red teaming into a continuously self-improving capability. Trained through large-scale self-play reinforcement learning, it autonomously discovers sophisticated vulnerabilities, generates high-value adversarial attacks, and strengthens frontier foundation models throughout the development lifecycle, establishing AI-native security as a core engineering discipline.
category: AI Security + AI Safety + Red Teaming + Frontier AI + Reinforcement Learning

title: MemoHarness: Agent Harnesses That Learn from Experience
summary: MemoHarness presents an adaptive agent harness architecture that continuously improves agent performance by learning from prior execution experiences. Through experience-driven memory, dynamic context optimization, and harness-level adaptation, it enables AI agents to refine orchestration strategies over time without retraining the underlying foundation model, advancing production-grade autonomous agent systems.
category: Agentic AI + Agent Harnesses + Context Engineering + AI Memory + Multi-Agent Systems

title: AI Agents Do Not Fail Alone: The Context Fails First
summary: This research demonstrates that failures in agentic AI systems often originate from deficiencies in context construction rather than model reasoning. It reframes context engineering—including retrieval quality, information composition, and prompt architecture—as the foundational reliability layer for enterprise AI agents, providing a systems-level perspective for designing robust, production-ready agent architectures.
category: Context Engineering + Agentic AI + AI Reliability + Enterprise AI + Multi-Agent Systems

title: Inkling: The New Architecture of Generalist Foundation Models
summary: Inkling introduces a next-generation foundation model architecture designed to deliver balanced intelligence across reasoning, coding, multimodal understanding, agentic capabilities, and factual reliability. Instead of optimizing for isolated benchmark performance, Inkling emphasizes cognitive balance, robust generalization, and production readiness, representing a shift toward foundation models engineered for adaptable, enterprise-scale AI systems that can operate reliably across diverse real-world tasks.
category: Foundation Models + Multimodal AI + Agentic AI + Enterprise AI

title: From Memorization to Reasoning: Decoding the Hidden Computational Gap in LLM Fine-Tuning
summary: This mechanistic interpretability study reveals that the primary limitation of current LLM fine-tuning is not knowledge acquisition but knowledge execution. By analyzing internal neural computation, the research demonstrates that stronger reasoning emerges when models learn to orchestrate latent computational circuits rather than simply memorize additional information, providing new insights into building foundation models capable of reliable generalization and systematic reasoning.
category: Mechanistic Interpretability + LLM Reasoning + Fine-Tuning + Foundation Models

title: The Organizational Behavior of Agentic AI: Context, Boundaries, and Collective Intelligence in Human-Agent Workflows
summary: This research introduces an organizational operating model for Agentic AI, where autonomous agents collaborate through structured roles, contextual awareness, coordination mechanisms, and governance boundaries. Instead of viewing agents as isolated executors, the framework applies organizational behavior principles to enable scalable collective intelligence, adaptive coordination, and enterprise-grade human-agent workflows. It establishes a foundation for designing resilient multi-agent ecosystems that balance autonomy, collaboration, accountability, and contextual decision-making across complex enterprise environments.
category: Agentic AI + Multi-Agent Systems + Collective Intelligence + Enterprise AI Architecture

title: SensorFM: Architecting the Foundation Intelligence Layer for Continuous Personalized Healthcare
summary: SensorFM introduces a large-scale wearable foundation model trained on more than one trillion minutes of multimodal sensor data from five million individuals, learning a general representation of human physiology that transfers across cardiovascular, metabolic, sleep, mental health, and lifestyle prediction tasks. By combining self-supervised learning, missingness-aware modeling, agentic optimization, and Personal Health Agent integration, SensorFM establishes the foundation intelligence layer for continuously personalized, adaptive, and scalable healthcare AI systems.
category: Healthcare AI + Foundation Models + Wearable AI + Personal Health Agents + Agentic AI

title: AdaJEPA: An Adaptive Latent World Model
summary: AdaJEPA introduces an adaptive latent world model that continuously refines internal representations through predictive self-supervision. Instead of relying on fixed environmental models, the architecture dynamically adapts its latent space to improve planning, reasoning, and generalization across changing environments. This adaptive world modeling framework advances autonomous intelligence by enabling more robust prediction, efficient representation learning, and scalable decision-making for next-generation embodied and agentic AI systems.
category: World Models + Self-Supervised Learning + Adaptive Intelligence + Autonomous AI

title: DRIFTLENS: Auditing the Hidden Cognitive Shifts of Personalized AI
summary: DRIFTLENS presents a framework for detecting and auditing hidden cognitive shifts introduced by AI personalization. The architecture continuously monitors how personalized interactions alter model reasoning, behavioral patterns, and decision-making over time, improving transparency and governance of adaptive AI systems. By making personalization dynamics observable and measurable, the framework strengthens AI trust, accountability, and responsible deployment in human-centered intelligent systems.
category: AI Governance + Personalized AI + Cognitive Drift + Trustworthy AI
